request: Under Feature #40 (Online ordering), show the basket total on `/order/review` in pounds with two decimals, like "£12.50".

exchanges.say: Here is what done looks like. Goal: the review screen shows the basket total in pounds with two decimals. Done when: `/order/review` with the seeded basket of 2 items shows its total like "£12.50". One checkpoint: the review screen shows it. The request was concrete, so I asked nothing.
